description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git bundle' functionality. It contains test cases, setup scripts, helper functions, and verification steps for different scenarios involving creating, verifying, and unbundling git bundles, including filtered, incremental, and tagged bundles.

methods.name: test_commit_setvar
methods.description: Creates a commit or tag and sets the given variable with the object ID, supporting options for merge commits, tags, and signed commits.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Returns an abbreviated object ID based on the given full object ID.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats git command outputs to replace commit hashes with placeholders for readability and stability.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Prepares expectation output files for comparison in tests.
